activities.name: Persist
activities.whenToUse: Reserved activity with no persistence implementation in the current branch. Use only to inspect the shared ReturnItemSignal behavior; do not choose it to save memory.
activities.description: Reserved memory persistence activity; its current branch has no implementation.

properties.description: Return ItemSignal after the reserved Persist branch when requested.
properties.whenToUse: Set true to return the current ItemSignal after the reserved Persist branch. Omit or false leaves no persistence result; this property does not implement saving.

resultNotes: No stable public Result field is available for this activity; inspect the Signal/effect at its actual boundary.

activities.name: Generate
activities.whenToUse: Use with a phase Plan containing ordered Steps. Each enabled step can dispatch a mapped adapter, register a result and conditionally format, transform or hydrate it. On the ordinary completed path the branch updates and awaits background phase tasks; early failure or no-result returns bypass that final wait and the trailing ReturnItemSignal check.

properties.description: Return ItemSignal after generating all steps when requested.
properties.whenToUse: Set true to return ItemSignal when Generate reaches the shared trailing resolver after ordinary step completion. Early failure or no-result returns bypass this check; omission defaults false.

properties.description: Enumerate phase steps for execution and step-to-step navigation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply ordered phase steps for Generate to select and clone. Omit or provide none when there are no steps to execute; Goto navigation also searches this collection.

properties.description: Identify step tracing and select the dispatched activity or Goto control flow.
properties.whenToUse: For a mapped adapter step, set the activity forwarded to Invoke-MappedAdapter. An Adapter-free Goto selects the target-search branch, but its current TestAllTrue call omits the required Operator and can fail before navigation.

properties.description: Identify step tracing and select the mapped adapter or goto branch.
properties.whenToUse: Set a mapped adapter name when this step should dispatch through Invoke-MappedAdapter. An absent Adapter with Goto Activity selects a currently limited branch whose enablement call lacks the required Operator.

properties.description: Forward the step configuration into its constructed deferred hydration plan.
properties.whenToUse: Supply step configuration when needed by its selected adapter or deferred hydration. Generate forwards the full step and copies Config into a constructed deferred hydration plan.

properties.description: Evaluate a diagnostic break condition for each step.
properties.whenToUse: Set true only for the current diagnostic assignment branch. It assigns a local Check value and does not itself stop or pause execution; omit or false for ordinary steps.

properties.description: Read the previous iteration counter before incrementing the original selected step.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the prior counter when Config.PreventReclone is true. GetNextStep reads it with zero default, increments the selected original step, then clones it.

properties.description: Decide whether to track an execution iteration before cloning the selected step.
properties.whenToUse: Set true when GetNextStep should track an iteration counter on the selected original step before cloning. Omit or false to clone without that increment.

properties.description: Offset the selected Goto target; a direct null-coalescing expression uses zero when null.
properties.whenToUse: On an Adapter-free Goto target-search path, this offsets the matched step index; omission or null coalesces to zero. The current Goto enablement call can fail before this offset is reached.

properties.description: Read the container used in missing-transform-result diagnostics.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a container label when missing transform results need a diagnostic location. The current branch reads it for that error message, not for choosing the transform slot.

properties.description: Select optional formatting of final step content.
properties.whenToUse: Set a final Format condenser activity when a step result should be formatted after optional transform and hydration. This branch runs only when a result is present and ExitAfterAdapter is false.

properties.description: Select deferred hydration applied before step execution.
properties.whenToUse: Set a hydration sequence to apply to the selected step before enablement and adapter dispatch. The constructed plan uses HydrationStyle Deferred and forwards step Config.

properties.description: Skip post-adapter formatting/transform/hydration when true.
properties.whenToUse: Set true to skip the post-adapter format, transform, hydration and final content-format block for a step with a result. It does not skip the subsequent step loop by itself.

properties.description: Return early when the adapter has no result and this flag is true.
properties.whenToUse: Set true to return from Generate early if the adapter step has no Result. Omit or false to continue the remaining step processing path.

properties.description: Select optional formatting before transformation.
properties.whenToUse: Set a Format condenser activity for formatting the adapter result before a Path-triggered transform. This branch requires a result and ExitAfterAdapter false.

properties.description: Select optional post-adapter hydration.
properties.whenToUse: Set a post-adapter hydration sequence for a result after optional formatting and transform. The branch clones the step, sets HydrationPlan and Path %.@, then dispatches Hydration.

properties.description: Read Goto enablement before target search; the current TestAllTrue call omits its required Operator and can fail.
properties.whenToUse: For an Adapter-free Goto, GetNextStep reads enablement with true default before intended target search. Its current TestAllTrue call omits the required Operator and can fail instead of following or falling through; do not rely on this Goto path as working navigation.

properties.description: Evaluate whether the step executes.
properties.whenToUse: Set the selected step's execution condition. Generate combines it through IsEnabledOperator; omitted value defaults true and a false decision skips the step body.

properties.description: Choose how step enablement values are combined.
properties.whenToUse: Choose how a selected step's IsEnabled values are combined by TestAllTrue. Omit to use And for the main step enablement check.

properties.description: Choose the key used to register step results.
properties.whenToUse: Set a nonempty registration key when the step's adapter or post-processing results should be stored on ItemSignal.Pointer. Omit to skip named registration.

properties.description: Choose the transform activity when a step Path is present.
properties.whenToUse: When Path triggers a transform, choose the activity sent to the selected transform condenser slot. Omit to use Select.

properties.description: Identify step tracing and match names during next-step and goto selection.
properties.whenToUse: Name the step for tracing and sequential next-step matching. Adapter-free Goto intends exact then suffix target search by Name, but its current enablement call can fail first.

properties.description: Select transformation data and the target name for Goto navigation.
properties.whenToUse: For an executed step, a truthy Path triggers transform dispatch. An Adapter-free Goto intends Path as a target name, but the current enablement call can fail before target search.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-phase reference while cloning.
properties.whenToUse: Retain an incoming parent-phase reference when cloning a selected step requires its lineage. Generate later assigns Phase from the current Plan on the working step before dispatch.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-plan reference while cloning.
properties.whenToUse: Retain an incoming parent-plan reference when Resolve-ClonePlan copies a selected step's lineage. Generate passes the current full phase as Plan and does not use this field to select an activity.

properties.description: Read the resource used in missing-transform-result diagnostics.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a resource label when missing transform results need a diagnostic location. The current branch reads it for that error message.

properties.description: Choose the transform condenser slot when a step Path is present.
properties.whenToUse: When Path triggers a transform, choose the transform condenser slot. Omit to use Transform; Mode then selects that slot's activity.

result.description: current ItemSignal [computed]. When ordered enabled steps, optional Key/Format/Path/Hydration/ContentFormat pipeline; ReturnItemSignal is true.

resultNotes: MemoryCondenser: success can have no Result (steps finish and ReturnItemSignal is false)
MemoryCondenser: A successful keyed Signal may have no Result; a later stage can overwrite its graph entry or fail
